name: 下班前上线

roles.name: 凌澈
roles.voice: young male, clean mid voice, flat and short, no smile, no rise, no breathiness, cold wording

roles.name: 砚舟
roles.voice: young male, clear warm voice, mid-low, chest-supported, slow and loose, one soft laugh at the end

roles.name: 旁白
roles.voice: young male news anchor, steady chest voice, clear diction, mid-low pitch, flat professional delivery

look: 半写实插画风格，细腻笔触与柔和光影，暖色灯光与冷色夜窗对比，安静的都市夜戏质感。
setting: 夜晚的室内：暖色灯光从一侧照过来，窗外透进深蓝色的夜光，暖冷对比。环境中任何可见文字都是中文。
constraints: 全片两个生成片段：第一段是当天夜里，第二段是第二天夜里，跨越一天由画外旁白在第二段开头点明（此处不裁剪续接帧，旁白不会被剪掉）。机位固定，角色1在画面左侧，角色2坐在书桌前的位置，全程都在画面内；一方说话时另一方的嘴唇保持闭合。角色3只出声不出镜。角色1语气急躁、催得紧，角色2语气慢而稳。全程中文对话。画面中只有这两名角色。
source_script:
角色1：小程，下班前新版本一定要上线！
角色2：好的，没问题！
角色2离场：关门出去。
角色1离场：他转身跟着走了出去。
角色3：第二天
角色1入场：开门进来
角色2入场：他已经在书桌前的转椅里坐好，抬头看向门口。
角色1：新版本怎么还没上线？
角色2：我还没下班呢

events.text: 小程，下班前新版本一定要上线！
他已经在书桌前的转椅里坐好，抬头看向门口。

execution.look: A semi-realistic illustration style with fine brushwork and soft light, contrasting warm lamp glow against cool night light from the window, in the quiet mood of an urban night scene.
execution.setting: Night indoors: warm light falls from one side while deep blue night light comes through the window, warm against cool. Every legible text in the environment is in Chinese.
execution.visible_state: Warm lamp light falls from one side and deep blue night light comes through the window, keeping the frame warm against cool blue. Character 1 stands on the left of frame facing right with a cool, flat, unhurried expression, a grey scarf held at his neck. Character 2 sits on the right of frame in the swivel chair at the desk, facing left, a cup of tea in his hand, looking up calmly.

voices.character_1: young male, clean mid voice, flat and short, no smile, no rise, no breathiness, cold wording
voices.character_2: young male, clear warm voice, mid-low, chest-supported, slow and loose, one soft laugh at the end
voices.character_3: young male news anchor, steady chest voice, clear diction, mid-low pitch, flat professional delivery

directions.event_003: Character 2 pushes the door shut and walks out of frame.
directions.event_004: Character 1 turns around and follows him out of frame.
directions.event_006: Character 1 opens the door and steps into the room, still mid-sentence.
directions.event_007: Character 2 is already seated in the swivel chair at the desk, looking up toward the door with a cup of tea in his hand.
